about.title: Henan Kangdar Pet Supplies Co., Ltd.
about.description: Founded in 2012, Henan Kangdar Pet Supplies Co., Ltd. is the manufacturer behind the KANGDARPET brand. We design and produce plush, rubber, rope and interactive dog toys, offering OEM & ODM services for pet brands, wholesalers and retailers across Europe, North America, South America and Central Asia.
highlights: Established in 2012 in Nanyang, Henan, China
Products certified to CE and EU Standard requirements
Exporting to Europe, North America, South America and Central Asia

items.quote: KANGDARPET developed our entire plush line from scratch. Quality is consistent across every shipment and communication is always fast.
items.name: Emily Carter

items.quote: Their rubber chew toys passed all our EU safety tests on the first try. The small MOQ helped us launch new designs with low risk.
